uutiset.t: 'Unbelievable' - how Spurs teenager Williams-Barnett impressed on first start
uutiset.s: Match of the Day pundit Joe Hart explains how teenager Luca Williams-Barnett caused problems for Ipswich Town on his first Premier League start for Tottenham in their 2-0 home win.

uutiset.t: I wish referee had opportunity to see 'handball' again - Hart
uutiset.s: Match of the Day pundits Joe Hart and Alan Shearer disagree with Morgan Rogers being penalised for handball, as the Chelsea forward "didn't make himself bigger" with the use of his arms in his side's 4-1 defeat to Leeds United in the Premier League.

uutiset.t: France thrash Argentina to reach Nations Championship final
uutiset.s: France beat Argentina 45-17 in Paris to set up a clash with South Africa in the Nations Championship final at the Allianz Stadium.

uutiset.t: London City keep up title hunt with emphatic win over Crystal Palace
uutiset.s: London City Lionesses stay in the hunt for the Women's Super League title, with a statement second-half performance to give them a 6-2 win over Crystal Palace.

uutiset.t: Alcaraz to face Zverev in ATP Finals title decider
uutiset.s: Carlos Alcaraz will face world number one Alexander Zverev for the ATP Finals title after completing a superb comeback victory against Ben Shelton.

uutiset.t: 'They looked like a team again' - Hearts roar back with Dundee demolition
uutiset.s: After a worrying week before the international break, Hearts respond is style by thrashing Dundee 8-0 at Dens Park.

uutiset.t: Highlights: Wallabies edge Wales in Cardiff
uutiset.s: Watch the best of the action as Australia edge Wales in Cardiff

uutiset.t: Scotland kept 'foot on throat' in ruthless display - captain McDowall
uutiset.s: Stand-in captain Stafford McDowall praises Scotland for keeping their "foot on the throat" of opponents Japan in their thumping 67-5 Nations Championship win.

uutiset.t: Kim holds one-shot lead at LPGA finale as Korda closes in
uutiset.s: A-Lim Kim holds a slender lead going into the final round of the CME Group Tour Championship, with world number one Nelly Korda among the chasers.

uutiset.t: Can win over All Blacks finally break England's boom-bust cycle?
uutiset.s: Twelve months ago, England beat New Zealand and flopped in the following Six Nations. Can their 2026 success pave the way to more permanent success?

uutiset.t: Australia hold on for narrow win against Wales
uutiset.s: Wales could not emulate their famous victory against New Zealand as Australia claimed the Nations Championship spoils in Cardiff.

uutiset.t: France secure Nations Championship final with Springboks
uutiset.s: France dispatch Argentina in Paris to book their spot against South Africa in the Nations Championship final at Allianz Stadium next Sunday.

uutiset.t: Rising star Stirling knocks out Prochazka
uutiset.s: Rising star Navajo Stirling earns the biggest win of his career as he knocks out former champion Jiri Prochazka in the second round at UFC Qatar.

uutiset.t: Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
uutiset.s: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.

uutiset.t: Ireland remind themselves that the best are beatable
uutiset.s: Ireland put a string of deflating losses against the world's best teams behind them with a hard-fought 20-17 win over South Africa in Dublin.
